newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia trade deficit drops in first nine months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia trade deficit drops in first nine months.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit during the first nine months of 1996 stood at 1.58 billion dinars, down by 6.3 percent compared to 1.69 billion dinars during the same period last year, official figures showed.
Exports totalled 3.89 billion dinars, up by 2.8 percent compared to 3.38 billion dinars, and imports were worth 5.47 billion dinars, about the same amount as in the same period last year.

The figures, obtained by Reuters and not yet officially released, showed that the decrease in imports was partly due to a drop in food purchases by 32.4 percent, after they increased by 98.3 percent during the same period last year because of drought. ($=0.97 dinar)
